name: Ulrick Mal-Karash
bio: A rebel private whose brothers were killed in front of him by orc captors. The slavers named him Mal-karash, oathbreaker. Agni marked him in Campess Port, the Nogratis train gave him lycanthropy, and now he is Agni's Harbinger of Judgement and carries the Scales. D.E.R.E.K. insists he has been a centaur in every timeline since Session 59. He has not.
tag: Loads oil barrels onto boats. Swings an 80-foot glaive. Smites.

name: Durzo Flint
bio: A half-elf who owes his life to a debt his parents paid with his sister's soul. Nyxara marked him in the sewers of Campess Port, and at her citadel she named him her Emissary of Death. He can summon Elara to fight beside him. He is the team leader, and he never lies.
tag: Also known as the Grim Weeper.

name: Gideon Fleshripper
bio: A fairy necromancer who flew into the story on Mt Mistmourne and remembers nothing from before. He is marked by both death and nature and commands skeleton armies. At the end of time he was hailed as Gidlion the Colossal and brought life back to the World Tree.
tag: Keeps a well of souls in his cabin.

name: Fiddle Blackthorn
bio: Freed from Fireholm Prison, he won his freedom in a pit fight against the man sent to rescue him. He is Blibdoolpoolp's little barnacle, keeper of the Chaos, Madness and Terror dice and the Conch. He summons whales and is now the ship's surgeon, qualified by at least five observed operations.
tag: D.E.R.E.K. insists a certain rumour about him is now true in every timeline.

name: D.E.R.E.K.
bio: Also known as Chadron. A one-eyed golden construct with luscious lips, rescued from a swamp prison by his own astral projection. He rewinds time, believes he is the real god of time (Chronos would disagree), flies the Skycrest, is The One to an entire realm of modrons, and is father to B.0.B. He hates his brothers.

name: B.0.B.
bio: A small construct on a quest to learn about all the wonderful foods of the world. He is addicted to grapes, raised by D.E.R.E.K. and Ulrick together, and deadly to impostors.

name: Borak "The Bull" Stonefist
bio: A Scottish dwarf barbarian and his tribe's attorney. He is a terrible lawyer who wins by intimidation. He took Ulrick's case in Nogratis and lost, because the court was rigged.
tag: Outbid everyone at the auction house for an item he didn't want.

name: Nate Wavecrest
bio: Human warlock, pirate, and one of the last of a sailing dynasty chosen by the Mad Sea Mother. At Muttonham he double-crossed Auril herself and sent a ship over the waterfall onto three hundred Frost Wardens, and the whole town chanted his name. He died once in the Nogratis caves and got better. The second time, walking into a haunted house with Lyrial, he didn't.
tag: Hero of Muttonham. Architect of the waterfall.

name: Lyrial Thorne
bio: An unwanted child from Dryton who learned to hide in plain sight moving goods through the docks. Agni marked him, Grub adored him, and he once spat on Auril's shrine and nearly died of it. He disappeared after the Nogratis jailbreak with only a stone-message left behind, and made his last stand in a house full of ghosts.
tag: Orphan, smuggler, bard, and Grub's best friend.

name: Gavin
bio: A human fighter who joined in Fireholm with one goal: get a certain prisoner out of Fireholm Prison. The prisoner was Fiddle. Gavin turned out to be a bit of a dick, so the team settled it with a pit fight. Fiddle won, resurrected Gavin, and won again.
tag: Came to rescue a prisoner. The prisoner killed him. Twice.

name: Lan
who: One of the originals · died early
bio: Stepped off the boat at Campess Port with the others, and was gone before the tale really began. As of Session 58 he still has no memorial.
